abstract: Install, serve, scale and troubleshoot NVIDIA Dynamo, the orchestration layer above vLLM, SGLang and TensorRT-LLM. Covers containers and ai-dynamo wheels, etcd or file discovery, the Kubernetes platform chart, DynamoGraphDeployment and DGDR manifests, disaggregated prefill/decode with NIXL, KV-aware routing, Planner, KVBM, load shedding, the OpenAI, Anthropic and KServe APIs, Prometheus metrics, upgrades and error fixes. Includes compose and Kubernetes templates. Verified against Dynamo v1.5.1.
